_doc: Coverage policy enforced by the PR policy workflow (tests-policy check) via scripts/coverage_tools.py gate. Scope: main.lua, weread/**/*.lua, integrations/**/*.lua; spec/, scripts/ and fixtures never count. 'combined' = unit specs + emulator scenarios (LuaCov in the real KOReader app). Targets turn blocking on their date; before it they are report-only. Each target may set combined_min, unit_min (overall) and module_unit_min ({pattern, min}: unit floor for every plugin file whose path matches the regex). Effective overall target = max(configured, day-one baseline of the same kind). The ratchet compares a PR with main's coverage at the PR's own base commit (first parent of the merge commit Integration measured, else merge-base with main), read from history.jsonl on the 'coverage' branch (keyed by main SHA; nearest recorded ancestor if that commit has no record; day_one_baseline if none has). Roadmap: docs/coverage-plan.md.
